server_read.description: Read a fact on a managed server with the sysadmin's reading tools (ssh-ro and its read-only commands). No change, no plan, no shell beyond the read-only gate.

platform_read.description: The monitor's state or a diagnostic from host logs the lead's own kd-host-read leaves out, read with the sysadmin's tools. The answer is a conclusion or the permitted output: no private audit records, no owner login or command history, no signatures. No change, no installation.

code_read.description: Read the code, history or docs of a project from the read-only repository copies. No commit, no PR.

server_change.description: Prepare and carry out the server steps of the lead's approved card: the helper opens its own admin card with a plan made from the lead's rollout sheet. A plan made only of the catalog's steps of a test environment is approved by the cabinet's rule and runs at once — the answer says what each step showed; any other plan waits for the owner's signature, and the answer names the helper's card.
